readme.text:
dsh-plugin-addir

让 DeepSeek Harness 支持多根目录工作区与上下文动态注入
灵感来自 OpenAI Codex --add-dir 与现代 AI IDE 多根目录工作区设计

简体中文 | English

---

在默认情况下，[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的工作区通常只绑定一个工作目录（Primary Root）。当面临以下复杂开发场景时常常受限：

- **跨仓库 / 跨模块协作**：前后端工程分离（如 `frontend/` 与 `backend/`），智能体需要同时理解接口定义与业务实现；
- **共享代码与公共库**：项目依赖独立的公共组件库（如 `shared-ui/`、`core-lib/`），需要跨目录检索却不想反复复制代码；
- **只读规格与文档参照**：引入只读的设计规范、API 契约或第三方代码，需要智能体参考但**绝不允许误改**。

`dsh-plugin-addir` 彻底打破单一工作区限制！它支持在当前工作区下**关联任意多个外部目录**，配合直观的图形化管理界面、自动上下文注入与细粒度只读保护，让智能体自如跨目录协同工作。

---

- 📁 **多根目录关联（Multi-Root Workspaces）**  
  支持为任意工作区挂载多个额外文件夹，为每个目录配置易记的别名（Alias）、描述信息及只读（Read-Only）标记。
- 🧠 **上下文动态注入（Context Injection）**  
  每轮对话自动将当前生效的目录树注入给大模型上下文。智能体可直接理解 `[别名]/path` 或 `别名:path` 路径简写。
- 🛡️ **细粒度只读防护（Read-Only Protection）**  
  勾选 `只读` 的目录将被文件工具守卫拦截 `write` / `edit` 操作，彻底避免智能体误改公共依赖或文档。
- 🖥️ **无缝原生 UI（Native GUI Integration）**  
  深度集成 DSH 工作区列表菜单（`⋯` → 编辑）。弹窗支持调用系统原生目录选择器，体验丝滑自然。
- 💾 **跨会话持久化（Auto Persistence）**  
  关联关系按工作区根路径隔离并持久化至本地存储（`$DSH_HOME/storages/addir.json`），应用重启后自动恢复。
- 🤖 **智能体自主管理（Agent Tools）**  
  内置 `addir_list`、`addir_add`、`addir_remove` 工具，允许智能体在对话中动态扩展视野；也可一键关闭权限，由用户完全掌控。
在工作区列表中点击目标项目的「`⋯`」按钮，选择「**编辑**」：

readme.section: 2. 多目录图形化管理弹窗
readme.text:
支持修改工作区名称、使用**系统原生目录选择器**添加文件夹、配置个性化别名，并可单独勾选「只读」权限：

---

readme.section: 注入到模型的上下文示例
readme.text:
启用 `enableContextInjection` 后，插件会在每轮对话自动向大模型注入当前工作区的生效目录表：

```markdown

- [primary] `/Users/dev/repo/frontend` (Primary root)
- [backend] `/Users/dev/repo/backend` - 核心 API 服务
- [specs] `/Users/dev/repo/api-specs` [Read-Only] - OpenAPI 契约定义
```

智能体能够据此识别每个目录的作用，并使用 `[backend]/src/app.ts` 或直接使用绝对路径进行高效分析。

---

1. **安装插件**（参考下方[安装指南](#-安装指南)）；
2. **关联目录**：在工作区列表点击「`⋯`」→「编辑」，点击「**添加文件夹**」选择本地目录，设置别名（如 `backend`）并保存；
3. **开始对话**：直接对智能体说：
   > *"请阅读 [backend] 目录下的路由定义，并在当前前端项目中生成对应的 API 请求函数。"*

---

readme.section: 1. 通过 DSH 插件市场 / 设置面板安装
readme.text: 打开 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端或 Web 端，进入 **设置 → 插件管理**，搜索 `dsh-plugin-addir`，点击安装即可。
```sh

readme.section: Web Profile（推荐在 Web 版使用）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-addir

readme.section: 注意：桌面端首次使用请先启动一次应用以初始化 profile，完全退出应用后再执行安装命令，随后重新打开应用
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-addir

dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-plugin-addir
```

> [!NOTE]
> 本插件自带 **bundle patch**（`cordis.patch.yml`），安装时会自动向 profile 注册 `id: addir`，**无需手动修改配置文件**。

readme.section: 3. 从源码构建安装（开发者模式）
readme.text: ```sh

git clone https://github.com/keatsyh/dsh-plugin-addir.git
cd dsh-plugin-addir

readme.section: 安装依赖并构建（prepare 会自动编译 lib/ 产物）
readme.text: pnpm install

readme.section: 软链接安装到目标 profile
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

---

所有配置项均有合理的默认值。您可以在 DSH 的**插件设置页**中直观调整，或在 profile 对应的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中进行配置覆盖：

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enableTools` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否向智能体暴露 `addir_*` 工具（允许模型自己增删目录） |
| `enableContextInjection` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否在每轮对话开始前向系统提示词注入工作区目录表 |
| `enforceReadOnly` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否在底层工具拦截对标记为只读目录的文件写入与编辑 |
| `defaultDirectories` | `Array` | `[]` | 启动时预先关联的静态目录列表（包含 `path`, `alias`, `description`, `readOnly`） |

```yaml
- id: addir
  config:
    enableTools: false           # 仅允许在 UI 界面中手动管理，禁止智能体自行增删
    enableContextInjection: true # 保持提示词注入

> [!TIP]
> 界面中所做的新增、编辑和删除操作，会实时持久化在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/addir.json` 中，按规范化工作区根路径索引，无需担心重启丢失。

---

当 `enableTools` 开启时，智能体可自主使用以下工具： | 工具名称 | 参数 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `addir_list` | — | 查看当前工作区已关联的所有目录（包括主根目录、别名、描述与只读标记） | | `addir_add` | `path` (必填)
`alias` (可选)
`description` (可选)
`readOnly` (可选) | 动态关联一个额外目录。支持传入绝对路径或相对工作区主目录的路径 | | `addir_remove` | `pathOrAlias` (必填) | 解除关联指定目录（支持按绝对路径或别名查找，主根目录不可移除） | 如不希望智能体拥有自主挂载权限，只需将配置中的 `enableTools` 设为 `false`。 ---

Q: 桌面端（Desktop）安装后没有出现「编辑」菜单？ 桌面端应用在首次安装插件时，需要完全退出应用进程（macOS 请使用 `Cmd + Q`，Windows 请从托盘或任务管理器完全退出），再次启动应用使客户端扩展脚本加载生效。
Q: 标记为只读的目录，智能体还可以阅读或搜索代码吗？ 可以。只读保护仅拦截 `write`、`edit` 等修改文件的工具调用，代码阅读（`read`）、检索（`grep` / `glob`）等完全正常运作。
Q: 可以在多个不同的工作区中使用相同的别名吗？ 可以。目录关联数据是严格按照各工作区的根目录路径隔离存储的，不同工作区之间的别名互不影响。
Q: 如何防止智能体自作主张关联新目录？

在 DSH 插件设置中将 **`enableTools`** 开关关闭（或在配置文件中设为 `false`），智能体将不再拥有 `addir_*` 工具，但您依然可以在 GUI 弹窗中手动管理目录。
</details>

---

pnpm install

pnpm run typecheck

readme.section: 构建打包（含 client bundle 语法检查与 d.ts 生成）

pnpm run build
```

dsh-plugin-addir

Multi-root workspaces and dynamic context injection for DeepSeek Harness
Inspired by OpenAI Codex --add-dir and modern AI IDE multi-directory workspace designs

简体中文 | English

---

By default, a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) workspace is restricted to a single root directory (`cwd`). Real-world development, however, frequently spans across multiple directories:

`dsh-plugin-addir` eliminates the single-workspace boundary! It enables you to **link arbitrary external directories** to your current workspace with intuitive graphical management, dynamic prompt context injection, and strict read-only protections.

---

- 📁 **Multi-Root Workspaces**  
  Associate multiple external folders with any workspace. Configure clean aliases, descriptions, and read-only flags for each.
- 🧠 **Dynamic Context Injection**  
  Automatically injects the active workspace directories into model prompt context on each turn. The agent recognizes paths like `[alias]/path` or `alias:path`.
- 🛡️ **Fine-Grained Read-Only Protection**  
  Intercepts `write` and `edit` file tool calls for directories marked `readOnly`, preventing accidental modifications to core libraries or specs.
- 🖥️ **Seamless Native GUI Integration**  
  Built directly into the DSH workspace action menu (`⋯` → Edit). The modal dialog invokes your system's native folder picker for a smooth experience.
- 💾 **Automatic Persistence**  
  Directory associations are keyed by normalized workspace root and persisted in local storage (`$DSH_HOME/storages/addir.json`), immediately restored across restarts.
- 🤖 **Agent Autonomy & Control**  
  Provides built-in tools (`addir_list`, `addir_add`, `addir_remove`) allowing agents to discover and link directories on demand, with a global kill-switch for full human control.
Click the「`⋯`」menu button on any workspace row and select「**Edit**」:

Rename the workspace, select folders using the **system native directory picker**, assign custom aliases, and toggle read-only restrictions:

---

When `enableContextInjection` is enabled, the plugin automatically appends active directory information to the model's system prompt:

```markdown

- [primary] `/Users/dev/repo/frontend` (Primary root)
- [backend] `/Users/dev/repo/backend` - Core backend API services
- [specs] `/Users/dev/repo/api-specs` [Read-Only] - OpenAPI schema contracts
```

The model can now reference files using shorthand like `[backend]/src/app.ts` or directly using absolute paths.

---
In DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web UI, navigate to **Settings → Plugins**, search for `dsh-plugin-addir`, and click Install.
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-addir

readme.section: Note: Launch the desktop app once first to initialize the profile. Quit it completely before running this command, then re-open the app.
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-addir

dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-plugin-addir
```

> [!NOTE]
> This package includes a **bundle patch** (`cordis.patch.yml`). It automatically registers `id: addir` into your profile configuration upon installation — **no manual configuration required**.
```sh

git clone https://github.com/keatsyh/dsh-plugin-addir.git
cd dsh-plugin-addir

readme.section: Install dependencies and build (prepare hook builds lib/)
readme.text: pnpm install

dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

---
Sensible defaults are provided out of the box. You can adjust them directly in the DSH Plugin Settings page or override them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enableTools` | `boolean` | `true` | Expose `addir_*` tools to the agent (permitting dynamic directory discovery/linking) |
| `enableContextInjection` | `boolean` | `true` | Inject active directories table into the prompt context before each turn |
| `enforceReadOnly` | `boolean` | `true` | Intercept write/edit operations inside directories marked as read-only |
| `defaultDirectories` | `Array` | `[]` | Static directories linked on startup (`path`, `alias`, `description`, `readOnly`) |

```yaml
- id: addir
  config:
    enableTools: false           # Manage directories via UI only; prevent agent self-linking
    enableContextInjection: true # Keep prompt context injection active

> [!TIP]
> All directory associations configured via the GUI are stored in `$DSH_HOME/storages/addir.json`, indexed by normalized workspace root paths, and persist across restarts.

---

| Tool Name | Parameters | Description | |---|---|---| | `addir_list` | — | List all directories currently linked to this workspace (roots, aliases, descriptions, and read-only flags) | | `addir_add` | `path` (required)
`alias` (optional)
`description` (optional)
`readOnly` (optional) | Associate an additional directory with the workspace (supports absolute or relative paths) | | `addir_remove` | `pathOrAlias` (required) | Unlink an associated directory by path or alias (primary root cannot be removed) |

If you prefer to manage linked directories strictly by hand, set `enableTools: false`.

---

Q: Why doesn't the "Edit" menu option show up in Desktop after installation? When installing plugins for the Desktop profile, ensure the desktop application process is completely terminated before running the install command (on macOS, use `Cmd + Q`; on Windows, quit from system tray / task manager), then restart the application to load the newly registered client bundle.

Q: Can the agent still read and search code in read-only directories? Yes, absolutely. Read-only protection specifically intercepts mutating operations (`write`, `edit`). Read operations (`read`, `grep`, `glob`) function normally without restriction.
Q: Can different workspaces use the same alias name?

Yes. Directory configurations are isolated per workspace root path. An alias like `backend` in Workspace A will not conflict with Workspace B.
Q: How can I prevent the agent from adding directories on its own? Disable **`enableTools`** in plugin settings (or set `enableTools: false` in your configuration). The agent tools will not be registered, while full manual management in the GUI remains available.
---
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm run typecheck

readme.section: Build (validates client bundle syntax & generates d.ts declarations)
readme.text:
pnpm run build
```

> **Architecture Note**: Client scripts are registered through classic runtime wrappers (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) and consume host-provided React instances. The workspace menu entry point is dynamically mounted via a resilient DOM adapter (`src/client/workspace-menu.ts`).
